name: De Mores company office and store
evidence: Photographed winter 1883-84 (houghton:3013533); labelled "company store" in the 1919 panorama (HAG plate p. 402). Locate from the panorama and the 1885-86 overviews.

name: Medora Stage & Forwarding Co. office, warehouse and baggage room
evidence: Line ran Oct 1884-May 1885 (HMdb 88033, 303699). One building on its original site in 1957 (BROOKS57).

name: Medora school
evidence: "A new school building has been erected" (Bismarck Weekly Tribune 1885-11-20); photo shsnd:00042-00037 "new schoolhouse".

name: Stockyards
evidence: Pens planned 50x50, then 100 ft square (Cow Boy 1885-04-16); NP to build large stock yards (Dickinson Press 1885-01-03).

name: Malloy's new building on Main Street
evidence: Mrs. Malloy moved from the Western House to her new building on Main St, July 1885 (Cow Boy 1885-07-16); torn down and moved to Dickinson June 1887.

name: Paddock's building for the Boston clothing house
evidence: Nearly finished June 1885 (Cow Boy 1885-06-25); Paddock's residence moved to Dickinson in sections June 1887.

name: Sylvane Ferris's house
evidence: Two-story section with bay window and porch wing (shsnd:00129-00012).

name: De Mores rental houses ("Houses to be let")
evidence: shsnd:00042-00030 etc.; St. Paul Daily Globe 1884-02-13 mentions "numerous small residence houses."

name: De Mores brick business block (planned)
evidence: Two store rooms below, offices above (St. Paul Daily Globe 1884-02-13). Was it built?

name: The Marquis's ice dam
evidence: "the Marquis built a dam nearby for the purpose of securing ice" near the trestle (HAG).

name: Gifford Bros. & Co. general store, Little Missouri
Other 1883 Little Missouri saloons (Smith & Stevens; Edgar & Saebastian; J. J. Smith)
Paddock's cabin and livery, Little Missouri
evidence: "'Little Misery.' Paddock's cabin in foreground, 1880" (Haynes, in NPSHB).
